messages:
marie: Quick design review — I'm proposing a compact floating mini-toolbar for the playground chat when streaming is active. It would surface: a single stop/pause affordance, a small realtime token meter, and a prompt-library quick-insert button. Sketch: https://redwood.design/mini-toolbar (mock) ash: Nice. Can you call out the placement constraints? mobile vs desktop? marie: Desktop only for v1. Idea is bottom-right, above the composer controls, so it doesn't obscure suggestions. On narrow viewports it collapses to a single icon to avoid occluding text. sam: Implementation note: attaching a live token counter that updates every chunk could be noisy — we should debounce updates to 250ms to avoid layout jank. Also streaming stop is just sending a cancel, right? ash: Agreed on debounce. For stop/regenerate UX: two states — "Interrupt" (stops stream but keeps partial response in place) and "Abort+Regenerate" (force stop then clear+regen). We should avoid putting both as primary actions. Maybe a primary "Stop" and a secondary overflow for "Regenerate". ben: UX thought: show a tiny token delta next to the prompt insert button when a prompt from the lib will add X tokens. Something like "+24 tokens" on hover. Helps cost awareness. kai: Accessibility nits: make the streaming region an `aria-live=\"polite\"` so screen readers don't repeat every chunk, and ensure the stop/regenerate buttons are reachable by keyboard without focus-loss. Also the token meter should have a text alternative — `aria-label=\"token usage: 120 tokens\"`. a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: run keyboard-only flows, test NVDA/VoiceOver with aria-live, validate color contrast for token meter. marie: Good catches. Proposed microcopy for the stop button: primary label `Stop` with tooltip "Stop generation — partial response kept". For regenerate action: `Regenerate` with tooltip "Restart generation from the current prompt". Thoughts? ash: Microcopy feels clear. Can we shorten tooltips for discoverability? e.g., `Stop — keep partial` and `Regenerate — restart` so they don't overflow on narrow panels. sam: Engineering constraint: if we keep partial response and users press Regenerate, we need to either append or replace. I vote replace by default and show an undo toast: "Response replaced — undo". Easier to reason about for state. ben: Agree on replace + undo. Also for the token meter design, propose 3 visual density modes: collapsed (dot + number), compact (small bar + #), expanded (full sparkline). Default to compact. kai: For keyboard nav: toolbar should be focusable in reading order, and `Esc` should move focus back to composer and optionally stop streaming. Confirm if `Esc` semantics conflict with other shortcuts. marie: Good point. Let's reserve `Esc` for stop+focus-back. We can add a toggle in Settings for power users. ash: One more accessibility: when the prompt-library quick-insert is used, the panel should not steal focus from the composer; insert should be inert if user is mid-composition unless they explicitly choose "Insert and focus". Otherwise screen reader context jumps. sam: Implementation sketch for aria-live and token label:```html
\n
...chunk...
\n
\n120\n``` marie: Perfect. For the prompt library quick insert microcopy, propose: primary action `Insert` and a caret for a small menu with `Insert & focus`. Also show `+X tokens` inline. ben: One UX risk: the floating toolbar could cover the composer suggestions. We should detect overlap and nudge it left or float above the composer when suggestions are open. ash: Can we add a simple animation when toolbar appears (fade+lift)? Keep motion reduced when OS prefers-reduced-motion. kai: Yes respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Also ensure the token meter doesn't rely on color alone (use icons/labels) for contrast. marie: OK next steps: ash to refine comps with compact/expanded modes; sam to prototype debounce + `Esc` handling; ben to spec prompt-lib insert token delta; kai to run quick a11y pass on comps. I'll pick this up in the next design sync. :sparkles: ash: Thanks — adding a short checklist to the PR description when ready. :+1: sam: I'll spin up a quick prototype branch later today — will paste GIF. ben: I'll write the quick-insert tooltip strings and the undo toast copy: "Response replaced — Undo" / "Undo". kai: Will run VoiceOver test once comps are in Figma. marie: Thanks all. Closing for now, will post updated comps. :eyes:
